name: Account Range
detail: Custom account-number allocation has not been implemented.

name: Alarms
detail: Server monitoring exists; trunk and call-event alarms are incomplete.

name: Automated Report
detail: Interactive reports and exports exist; automated generation needs a worker.

name: Access Control
detail: Role and navigation permissions exist; portal/API IP rules need implementation.

name: Advanced SIP Routing
detail: Route preview and fraud rules exist; cause-based extension failover is not installed.

name: Automated CDRs
detail: CDR records exist; scheduled summaries are incomplete.

name: ACL Management
detail: Network controls exist; a unified SIP ACL module is incomplete.

name: Country Reports
detail: Country-level usage and revenue reporting has not been implemented.

name: Demand-Based Routing
detail: Effective-date rate scheduling exists; time-window live routing is incomplete.

name: DID Call Transfer
detail: Disposition-based DID failover is not installed.

name: Fax over IP
detail: Requires a fax engine, storage and provider/media integration.

name: Fraud Detection
detail: Destination blocks and prepaid concurrency checks exist; anomaly detection is incomplete.

name: International Credit Management
detail: Separate international spending limits are not implemented.

name: Local Number
detail: DID inventory exists; shared-DID service routing is incomplete.

name: Logs
detail: Operations controls exist; redacted live service-log streaming is incomplete.

name: Languages
detail: Language/locale settings exist; full interface translation coverage is incomplete.

name: Mailchimp
detail: Requires an integration implementation and authorized Mailchimp credentials.

name: Multi-Tenant IP PBX
detail: Tenant-scoped PBX records exist; live IVR, queues and voicemail need a media/PBX engine.

name: Number Portability Service
detail: Port-request records exist; global portability lookup requires a data provider.

name: Ported Number—South Africa
detail: Requires a South African portability dataset/API and implementation.

name: Personalized Rates
detail: Account-specific live tariff overrides are not implemented.

name: Payfast
detail: Requires a signed webhook/payment integration and merchant credentials.

name: Rate Simulator
detail: A tariff route preview exists; it does not prove live switch rating.

name: Stripe Payment Gateway
detail: Stripe management exists; every advertised payment flow is not implemented.

name: Support Ticket
detail: Existing tenant-scoped tickets, replies and status actions are available.

name: Schedule Reports
detail: Scheduled emailed reports need durable scheduling, recipients and SMTP.

name: Shadow Billing
detail: A separate shadow-rating ledger is not implemented.

name: Switch Monitoring
detail: Kamailio readiness exists. Native FreeSWITCH monitoring is outside the selected architecture.

name: Two-Factor Authentication
detail: Passkeys and OTP flows exist; exact vendor MFA parity is not established.

name: WHMCS integration
detail: Requires a WHMCS connector and authorized API account.

name: Zoho CRM integration
detail: Requires CRM connector implementation and OAuth authorization.

name: Salesforce integration
detail: Requires CRM connector implementation and OAuth authorization.

name: STIR/SHAKEN
detail: Requires approved signing credentials, certificate lifecycle and SIP integration.

name: Mobile Dialer
detail: App download controls exist; native background-calling acceptance remains separate.

name: PC Dialer
detail: Web calling exists; full desktop dialer parity is not established.

name: Prepaid & postpaid charging
detail: Kamailio prepaid deployment exists. Postpaid, prorating, bundles and surcharge rules remain incomplete.

name: DID lifecycle
detail: Inventory/provider controls exist; full purchase/release/recurring lifecycle depends on integrations.

name: Call center & autodialer
detail: PBX/call-center controls exist; live AMD, IVR, conferencing and interception need compatible engines.

name: SMS delivery & billing
detail: SMS endpoints exist; provider acceptance and full SMS rating remain incomplete.

name: Resellers & commissions
detail: Tenant roles exist; hierarchical reseller rating, commissions and provider portals are incomplete.

name: Archive, purge & cron
detail: Retention/archive workers and scheduled job administration are incomplete.

name: n8n integration
detail: Requires authenticated workflow connectors and an n8n instance.
